text:
Marta: Quick planning thread  finalizing the multi-locale newsletter sequence for the benchmark launch + webinar. Need localization, subject variants, and a small referral incentive for sign-ups.
Noah: thumbs up. Proposed flows: 1) Invite (localized language + local send time) 2) Reminder (highlight local case study) 3) Live day (calendar add) 4) Post-event report + referral ask.
Sofia: For locales: en-US, en-GB, fr-FR, de-DE, ja-JP. We'll need translated subject+preheader + 1 localized customer quote. Can we use our translation team + automated pass for small tweaks?
Ethan: yes. workflow: translate -> linguist QA (only for ja/fr/de) -> staging render. Auto-translate fallback for en-GB (variant of en-US).
Marta: Send windows: local 09:00 for each region. For JP use 10:00 local to avoid commute. Also stagger big cohorts over 3 waves to protect deliverability.
Noah: Subject experiments: metric-led vs narrative lead. Examples:
- metric-led (EN): "Benchmark: 3.2x throughput, 38% cost reduction"
- narrative (EN): "See how one team sped up inference without blowing the budget"
Also test from-name A/B: "Redwood" vs "Redwood Inference".
Sofia: We'll include a localized CTA label and a 1-line localized snippet for dedicated customers: "Dedicated customers: priority demo slot". Tag these recipients with dedicated_followup=true.
Ethan: Segment queries (sample SQL) for DF pulls:
```
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE persona_tag = 'eng-lead'
  AND last_seen > now() - interval '270 days'
  AND email_opt_in = true
  AND locale IN ('en-US','en-GB','fr-FR','de-DE','ja-JP');
```
```
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE persona_tag = 'pm'
  AND product_usage_score > 0.4
  AND email_opt_in = true
  AND company_size BETWEEN 10 AND 500;
```
Marta: suppression list: previous_webinar.no_emails, bounced_90d, partner_contacts, and users with email_do_not_send=true.
Noah: Referral incentive: after event, registrants get a referral link to share. Referral reward: 1-month free Dedicated trial credit (applies to eligible accounts). Include T&Cs link in post-event email.
Sofia: Analytics & UTM: utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_q3, utm_medium=email, utm_content={locale}_{variant}. Events: nl_open, nl_click, nl_register, referral_click, referral_convert. Also map registrant to lead_score pipeline with source=newsletter_benchmark.
Ethan: Deliverability ops: ramp 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% (12h). Seed list of 150 incl ISP monitors. Monitor spam complaints > 0.04% to pause. Also check engagement-based throttle: pause sends to segment slices with <1% open within 3h.
Marta: QA checklist: localized render (Gmail/Outlook/iOS/Android), calendar .ics per locale, link check, accessibility alt text, translations verified. Also confirm calendar timezone lines up.
Noah: Timeline: Translations Tue AM, copy freeze Wed EOD, DF pulls Wed night, QA Thu, ramp Fri for NA/EMEA, APAC Mon local. Post-event referral send Mon after webinar.
Sofia: I'll coordinate translations and provide the localized subject variants. Will attach sample translations in this thread.
DeliverBot: staging preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/newsletters/2987654321-preview - renders passed for en-US and fr-FR seeds.
Marta: Perfect. Noah please paste segment counts once DF runs. Sofia, ping me in the thread when translations land. Locking plan. :sparkles:
